description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It provides mechanisms for validating values against expected ranges, regex patterns, or custom functions, and managing multiple validators.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for representing expected values which can be a range, discrete set, or regex pattern, and provides validation methods.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class for validating values of type T using expected values or custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class for managing multiple validators, adding new validators, and performing validation checks with optional logging.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the expected criteria, supporting different types of validation including regex, range, or discrete set.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the ValidationManager, either from ExpectedValues or a custom function.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logging function for validation messages.
